metaDescription: PulsePatch is a stick-on emergency response patch that helps bystanders start and maintain effective CPR during cardiac emergencies.

hero.title: Stick. Detect. Guide. Save.
hero.description: PulsePatch is a stick-on emergency response patch designed to help bystanders act fast during sudden cardiac arrest by giving real-time CPR guidance and compression feedback.

heroCard.title: Why this matters
heroCard.description: There is a critical gap between collapse and effective intervention. PulsePatch aims to reduce hesitation, improve CPR quality, and buy time until EMS or AED support arrives.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.subtitle: Survival outcomes in sudden cardiac arrest depend on immediate and correct bystander action, but panic and uncertainty often delay or reduce CPR quality.

cards.delayText: Many bystanders hesitate before taking action in high-stress emergencies.
cards.techniqueText: Common CPR mistakes include poor rhythm, inconsistent compressions, or no compressions.
cards.guidanceText: AEDs are not always immediately available, and existing monitors do not actively coach intervention.

solution.title: The PulsePatch Solution
solution.subtitle: A zero-friction adhesive patch that transitions from detection to active CPR guidance in seconds.

howItems.i1: Stick patch on the chest and auto-activate.
howItems.i2: Capture ECG and motion signals (IMU-based detection).
howItems.i3: Trigger coaching mode when no response is detected.
howItems.i4: Guide compression pace and consistency with real-time feedback.

market.title: Target Users and Go-To-Market
market.subtitle: PulsePatch focuses first on environments where emergency readiness matters and rapid response can save lives.

business.b3: Future subscription for data and app layer

roadmap.title: Development Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Execution plan from prototype to regulatory pathway and pilot validation.

phases.p1Text: IMU-based compression detection, metronome + LED feedback, basic patch form factor.
phases.p2Text: ECG integration, state detection logic, improved UX and enclosure design.
phases.p3Text: CPR mannequin testing, controlled user studies, iterative feedback optimization.
phases.p4Text: Clinical trials, FDA submission, certification workflow.

invest.title: Partnership and Investment Opportunity
invest.subtitle: We are looking for collaborators and early supporters to accelerate prototyping, testing, and regulatory preparation.

support.s1: Prototype hardware and industrial design refinement
support.s2: Signal processing and feedback algorithm development
support.s3: User testing and pilot study setup
support.s4: Regulatory strategy and clinical validation planning

invest.riskText: Technical noise and false positives/negatives, regulatory burden (likely Class II path), and high-stress UX clarity are key risks actively considered in the product plan.

footer.note: PulsePatch is presented as a concept-stage emergency response aid and is not represented here as a diagnostic or defibrillation device.
